create.name: Zen Center North Shore
create.bio:
Zen Center North Shore is a Soto Zen community serving the North Shore of Boston and the wider New England region, now based in a sangha house in Amesbury, Massachusetts. Myozen Joan Amaral started it in 2012 as the Marblehead Zen Center, meeting at first in a church there; it moved to Beverly in 2014, took its present name in 2016 and later bought its Amesbury home.

Joan came east from San Francisco Zen Center after six years of training at Tassajara and received dharma transmission from Zenkei Blanche Hartman, in the Shunryu Suzuki line. A former modern dancer, she also completed chaplaincy training at the Sati Center and once taught meditation in the San Francisco county jail. Her teaching links sitting practice with self-care, creativity and ordinary, untidy daily life.

The daily schedule of zazen, walking meditation and chanting runs in person from Tuesday to Sunday, with Monday mornings online, and every period is also open on Zoom without charge. Newcomers can join a Saturday introduction class or a free one-to-one Zoom introduction, and a lunchtime Community Zen session meets weekly at the Beverly Public Library. Monthly day-long sits and longer sesshin, with oryoki meals and time with the teacher, round out the year.

courses.title: Monthly Sesshin
courses.description: An evening and a full day of silent zazen with walking meditation, oryoki meals, a dharma talk from the guiding teacher and a chance to meet her one to one. Register by email and say whether you need overnight housing; online sitters can join the morning period on Zoom.
courses.price: suggested donation is $50 or whatever you can afford

courses.title: Private Meditation Instruction with Myozen Joan Amaral
courses.description: One-to-one meditation instruction with the founder and guiding teacher, arranged by email or phone, with a donation to the teacher at whatever level suits you.
courses.price: Donation; the amount is entirely up to you

free_resources.title: Intro to Zen
free_resources.description: Ways in for beginners: a Saturday morning class on Zen basics in Amesbury, Community Zen sessions, and a free individual Zoom introduction with a senior student.

free_resources.title: Chants and Texts
free_resources.description: The centre's full service chant book and texts for the precepts, full moon ceremony and robe chant, readable online or as PDF downloads.

free_resources.title: Community Zen at the Beverly Public Library
free_resources.description: A weekly midday drop-in led by Joan Amaral: silent sitting, then a class with posture instruction, guided grounding meditation and time for questions.

About page says the Amesbury house was bought 'In October of 2026'; date not repeated in the bio.
